instructions:
The owner is not a programmer, so write each finding in plain business English: what breaks for the user, then the fix.

Also flag these, which the owner repeatedly asks agents to fix:
- UI clutter: eyebrow labels above titles, helper sentences under fields, captions explaining a section, repeated labels, bold body text, decorative icons, and controls that differ from the existing ones of the same type.
- Settings or feature switches added to .env or environment variables instead of the app's Settings page. Secrets and API keys belong in .env.
- New validation rules or document-specific prompt rules where a general principle or better agent feedback would do.
- Secrets, API keys or internal company references committed to the repo.
